credits.overview: Mariel and Tino, a documentary filmmaking duo specializing in disturbing crimes, investigate a tragedy that occurred a year earlier at a care home, where a young volunteer named Gisela set fire to a dormitory with several children inside. credits.title: Postmortem
credits.overview: Helena, a forensic medical investigator, is overwhelmed by grief after the death of her husband Richard. When she becomes obsessed with a disturbing new case, Helena starts to believe she can bring Richard back — unleashing a cascade of terrifying consequences.

credits.title: Brace for Danger
credits.overview: Detective Peyton Sherman is on a flight home, when the mysterious woman sitting beside her demands she reveal the location of social media influencer Erin Roberts, who is in hiding, before the plane lands if she ever wants to see her daughter again.

credits.title: Fleeting Reflections
credits.overview: Fabián, a young man who just lost his parents, moves to the mansion where his aunt Lili and his cousin Isabel live. As days go by, Fabián will notice the strange habits of his relatives seem to suggest they are something more than human.

credits.title: Quicksand
credits.overview: A married couple on the brink of divorce becomes trapped in quicksand while hiking through a Colombian rainforest. It’s a struggle for survival as they battle the elements of the jungle and must work together in order to escape.

credits.title: Tarumama
credits.overview: Sara and Óscar, a couple going through a marital crisis, decide to spend a week in a remote country cabin with their two children, Alicia and Tomás. credits.title: Vanity Mirror
credits.overview: A woman who fantasizes every night about being a beauty queen is suddenly tormented by a mirror that feeds on people's vanity.

credits.title: Bad Days
credits.overview: Emilia and her mother, Lucia, are forced into isolation after her stepfather, The Turk, steals a highly coveted cargo of emeralds. The unexpected arrival of two hired assassins to the cabin where mother and daughter are hiding unleashes an imminent danger.
